ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{2}{x}$ passes through the midpoint $D$ of side AB of the rectangle OABC. What is the area of the rectangle OABC?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw $DE \perp OC$ at point $E$,\\
since the graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{2}{x}$ passes through the midpoint $D$ of side $AB$ of rectangle $OABC$,\\
therefore, $S_{\text{rectangle }OABC}=2S_{\text{rectangle }OADE}$,\\
also, since $k=2$,\\
therefore, $S_{\text{rectangle }OADE}=2$,\\
therefore, $S_{\text{rectangle }OABC}=\boxed{4}$.

method.method_draft: Read the figure as a rectangle with O at the origin, OA along the positive x-axis, OC along the positive y-axis, and AB the right vertical side. Let OA = a and AB = b, so B = (a,b). Since D is the midpoint of AB, D has coordinates (a, b/2). From the text, D lies on y = 2/x, so b/2 = 2/a. Multiply by 2a to get ab = 4, which is exactly the area of rectangle OABC.
